plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: C3, C5 and C10 have no instrument that can go in a plan. C3 needs a check of each category against the requester's rule. C5 needs scope of a call, which can only be asked on named lines of the record. C10 needs trace of a call on named sending lines, which costs 10 per line, so covering all 100 would cost 1000. I would also have wanted an instrument that reads the live tables after the promotion. same set and summary of the change read only the staged set.
